# Key Files — idle-base

<!-- generated by /kb-generate — last_crawl_commit: ece8760a02e784dba77a283ca07e2c1a39273b81 -->

Ordered by how much a contributor needs them, not by size. `package-lock.json` (7205L) is the
largest file in the repo and is irrelevant; `src/data/acts.js` is the one to read first.

## Read these before changing anything

| Path | Why it matters |
|---|---|
| `src/data/acts.js` | **Start here.** The six-act structure: each act's `rules` overrides, `modifierBonuses`, `unlocks` and machine-checkable `exit`. Its comments carry the measured tuning runs behind every number and are the closest thing to a design document in the source. 9 changes since crawl start — the most-touched config file. |
| `src/engine/tickEngine.js` | 505L. `advance(state, deltaSeconds)` — the single place simulation happens, live and offline alike. Game resolution, playoff rounds, offseason rollover, act transitions, camp completion, feed writes. Most cross-cutting stories need a hook here, and it is the most likely file for two parallel changes to collide in. |
| `src/state/initialState.js` | The shape of the entire game state, with comments explaining the rule for which slices are `null` (content an act creates) versus present-and-empty (collections `advance()` dereferences every iteration). Read before adding a slice. |
| `src/engine/modifiers.js` | `resolveRules()` (balanceConfig ← act ← era, replace semantics) and `computeModifiers()` (act ← era ← capsShop ← perks ← powerups, additive then clamped). Never read `balanceConfig` directly for anything an act can override. |
| `src/engine/progression.js` | Act transitions. `getUnlockedFeatures` (derived, never stored), `EXIT_PREDICATES` (what ends each act), `ACT_INITIALIZERS` (what each act creates on entry). |
| `src/persistence/saveLoad.js` | 38L, but it sets the hardest constraint in the repo: **no save migration**. A version mismatch discards the save, so every new slice must be readable when absent. |

## Entry points and wiring

| Path | Why it matters |
|---|---|
| `src/index.js` → `src/App.js` → `src/state/GameContext.js` | 8L / 13L / 20L. `createRoot` → `GameProvider` (useReducer over the whole game, hydrated from localStorage) → `AppShell`. |
| `src/components/layout/AppShell.js` | The router. `PANELS` map keyed by feature id, filtered through `getUnlockedFeatures`; locked tabs are not rendered at all. Early-returns a pre-season shell when `state.season` is absent, so every hook must sit above that return. Adding a tab means touching this and `TabNav.js`. |
| `src/state/gameReducer.js` | Flat switch delegating to `state/actions/*`. Shared seam — 8 changes; every feature adds a case *and* a require. |
| `src/state/actionTypes.js` | 8 changes. Every action type constant. |
| `src/hooks/useGameTick.js` | 37L. The only timer: 1s TICK, 30s autosave, offline catch-up on mount, save on `visibilitychange`/`beforeunload`. Note the unload save will clobber a hand-injected localStorage fixture during a reload. |

## Economy and simulation

| Path | Why it matters |
|---|---|
| `src/engine/income.js` | 10 changes — the most-changed engine file. Sums every per-second contributor into `{ caps, coins, cash }`. Where a new passive income source plugs in. |
| `src/engine/gameSim.js` | The **one** probability model in the game (`winProbability`, `simulateGame`). Everything that needs odds — games, wall-ball rallies, the bookie's line — routes through it. |
| `src/engine/strength.js` | `STAT_WEIGHTS`, `playerOverall`, `teamStrength`. Walk-up song bonuses apply here at read time. Consumed by the sim, the roster card, the trade panel and camp — so a change here moves everything at once. |
| `src/engine/wallBall.js` | 351L. Act II. Its header documents the recoverability invariant and what it does and does not guarantee — read it before touching stakes, cooldowns or Respect. |
| `src/engine/bookie.js` | 608L, the largest source file. Act IV wagering: moneyline plus the prop board. Note it widened two shared contracts — `settleWager` and `refundOpenWager` also settle/refund props. |
| `src/engine/concessions.js` / `src/data/concessionsConfig.js` | 248L / 330L. Five offer kinds: stands, boosters, caps click upgrades, cash click upgrades, stand multipliers. The most elaborate shop and the model to copy. |
| `src/engine/pacing.js` | Small but easy to get wrong: `gameSpeedMult` is the only modifier that **divides** a duration. All three consumers (game slot, playoff round, replay budget) route through here so the direction is decided once. |
| `src/engine/wallet.js` | Every currency write in the game. `creditWallet`/`debitWallet`/`canAfford`/`balanceOf`. |

## Presentation

| Path | Why it matters |
|---|---|
| `src/styles/global.css` | 2560L, the entire stylesheet. **Ends inside an `@media (max-width: 640px)` block** — appending at EOF silently scopes a rule to mobile. Use the feature-section markers near the end. |
| `src/components/layout/HeaderStats.js` | 8 changes. Currency chips with live rates and floating gains, the countdown, the folded season/record chip, the per-era colour pill. Space here is contested on a 390px screen. |
| `src/components/field/FieldView.js` | 4 changes. The on-field replay, sized to fit inside the gap between games. |
| `src/components/common/ToastHost.js` | Its header documents why toasts are derived from transitions and never stored — an offline catch-up would otherwise fire a storm on load. Read it before adding a toast. |
| `src/data/feedMessages.js`, `toastMessages.js`, `storyBeats.js`, `propBetsConfig.js` | All player-facing prose. A string literal in a component belongs in one of these. |

## Config reference

| Path | Why it matters |
|---|---|
| `src/data/balanceConfig.js` | Base tunables for a fresh run — league size, season length, pacing, costs, offline cap. Every act and era layers over this. |
| `src/data/modifierKeysConfig.js` | `BONUS_KEYS` and their clamps. A modifier key not in this list is silently inert. |
| `src/data/eras.js` | Prestige eras: rules overrides, bonuses, and each era's pill colour. Extrapolates past the authored five. |
| `src/data/currencies.js` | The three currencies and how each displays. Components must not hardcode a currency name — the click's currency is per-act overridable. |
| `src/data/positions.js`, `playerNames.js` | Roster vocabulary. Stat keys are `power`, `contact`, `speed`, **`defense`**, `pitching` — note `defense`, not `fielding`. |
| `docs/PRD-incremental-odyssey.md` | 710L. The PRD the act structure implements; §6.4 is the anti-softlock guarantee the engine comments cite. |
| `package.json`, `webpack.config.js`, `babel.config.js` | Two runtime deps (react, react-dom). Only `start` and `build` scripts — **no test runner**. |
